reason: I pick dinner from a video on the day and cook it, so I'm not going to scan receipts or plan a week. The free app I might try once, but I wouldn't pay for Plus.
objection: Why would I need a separate device on the counter when I have my phone? And I already pay for streaming and music, I don't want another subscription for something I don't do.
would_change_my_mind: If it let me save a recipe straight from an Instagram or TikTok video and showed me what I'm missing from what I already have, and the paid part stayed free for a good trial.
